data.narrative:
Tekever is a Series C stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $631M+ to date. The comparable universe consists of 6 private companies operating in the same sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this narrow category.

A stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using the $631M total capital raised as a valuation proxy. Applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to post-Series C transitions yields an implied valuation of $1.1B. A peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Drones & Autonomous sector—while five peers exist in the sector, none meet the threshold of three datapoints within narrowly defined filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $912M to $1.2B, with a median point of $1.1B. This single-method triangulation carries elevated uncertainty inherent to frontier-sector valuations with sparse comparable transactions. Key risks to this estimate include the early-stage nature of commercial autonomous systems adoption, regulatory clarity timelines, and the absence of publicly traded benchmarks in this subsector. Future rounds and transaction comps would materially refine this estimate.
